summary: GlobalTech Corp filed an 8-K reporting a 1-for-3 reverse stock split, approved by stockholders in December 2025 and implemented via Articles of Amendment filed with Nevada on August 24, 2026, effective August 27, 2026. No per-share price, premium, or value was stated; the action is a capital-structure adjustment, not a special situation. Shares trade on OTCQB under GLTK with a new CUSIP; fractional shares will be handled per board discretion. This is routine corporate housekeeping, so no risk-arb angle applies.
